summary: Performed deep static+integration audit for requested issue53 scope across companion bridges, tvOS premium routing, desktop Electron IAP/build flow, shared premium logic, live readonly API checks, and Expo web load sanity. Added runnable /app/tests/regression_issue53_*.cjs suites. Key regressions found: fake ISO mapping in AudioProvider watch country payload, DesktopPremium invalid paywall variant (TypeScript break), and multiple live TV/Desktop endpoint checks returning 404 on configured live API host.

integration_issues.issue: AudioProvider still derives country code via name.substring(0,2).toUpperCase(), violating no-fake-ISO selector requirement.

action_items: Fix AudioProvider requestCountries mapping to stop inventing pseudo ISO codes from country names.
Fix DesktopPremium paywall variant to a valid PaywallVariant and rerun web-preview tsc.
Fix PaywallContext onPurchase bridge variable shadowing/use-before-declaration (TS2448).
Fix remaining web-preview TypeScript errors (UpdateBanner union narrowing, Equalizer->Sidebar props).
Revalidate TV/Desktop backend route contract for /api/stream-resolve, /api/stream-proxy, /api/stream-metadata, /api/tv-app on the real user-facing host expected by app.
Update README_API_DEVELOPER.md with sanitized real subscription GET sample mapping (no secrets) if handoff requires strict contract proof.
